version.description: The version Go stamped on the build: the tag, such as v0.4.0, for go install at a tag or a build of a clean checkout at one; a pseudo-version, such as v0.0.0-20261021043753-563ff471b641, for a build elsewhere in a checkout, ending +dirty when it has changes not committed; (devel) when Go stamped none, as for go run or a build outside a checkout.

commit.description: The commit Go stamped on a build in a checkout; null when it stamped none, as for go install at a tag or go run.

format.description: The database format this binary reads.
